name: Messages
description: Renders Drupal status messages as modern, styled message cards.
project_description:
Transform your Drupal status messages with beautiful, modern card-based designs featuring wave backgrounds, smooth animations, and enhanced user experience. This module replaces default status messages with stunning visual cards that improve user engagement and site aesthetics.

 Features 
 Visual Design 

 
 Card-based layout with modern aesthetics 
 SVG wave backgrounds for visual appeal 
 Color-coded message types with intuitive icons 
 Professional typography and spacing 
 
 User Experience 

 
 Smooth CSS animations with hardware acceleration 
 Staggered animations for multiple messages 
 Manual close buttons with hover effects 
 Non-intrusive positioning options 
 
 Administrative Control 

 
 Comprehensive configuration interface 
 Individual message type enable/disable 
 Position and timing customization 
 Animation and visual effect toggles 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Requirements 

 
 Drupal 9.2+ (for core/once dependency) 
 PHP 7.4+ 
 Modern browser with CSS Grid support 
 
 Installation 

 composer require drupal/enhanced_status_messages 

 drush en enhanced_status_messages 

 drush cr 

 Configuration 

Navigate to Administration → Configuration → User Interface → Enhanced Status Messages or visit `/admin/config/user-interface/enhanced-status-messages`
